Text:
In my opinion, some advantages and disadvantages of studying from home contradict each other. For example, a pro would be that you have more control over your schedule and time management. But at the same time, that is a con because too many liberties in this area leads to disorganization thus, accumulating work and creating stressful situations. One advantage that (in my opinion) does not have a disadvantage is clothing options. While we are studying from home, we have more freedom over what we choose to wear. We have the option of wearing more comfortable clothing, or something that we like, opposing to the plain uniform. This also goes to hairstyle and in some cases make up. In a way, we can express ourselves more in terms of clothing. 
A disadvantage that we must face many times, is the problem when we do not understand something in a work we have to do or in the material we are studying. In these cases, teachers and parents tell us repeatedly, to contact our teachers with questions that we have. Either by Google Classroom or Gmail. The problem with this is, that we, as teenagers, do not know how to approach with the teachers with our question. Mainly because we are embarrassed, or do not want to bother our teachers. But in the cases that we do, in fact, contact them, they will most likely take days to respond, in which some assignments will already be due.
And the last thing I will write about is relationships with friends. Our school has disabled our ability to create meets of our own using our institutional mail. This has pushed us to search for alternative videocall platforms where we can talk to our friends and have fun. 
Overall, online school sucks.

Text:
The student’s perspective on the pandemic
The pandemic that we are living from last year made huge changes in our life, changes which we need to get used to. Thought we are living this from almost a year or so, it is very difficult to adapt to such a big change, but one of the big challenges we need to face is about the online education. The system that we are using from last year had brought advantages and disadvantages, which obviously are different for each. In the next paragraphs I am going to mention some of the main advantages and disadvantages about studying from home that this so known virus had brought to our lives.
At first, I will explain about some of the positive things that studying online can provide us. One of the things that most of the students are grateful with, is about not using the school uniform while being in classes, which makes studying in synchronic lessons a comfortable way of learning. Also, being in your own home makes studying a better experience, because you are in a familiar area, where it is easier to ask for help, as you are the hole day with your family.
Having a different organization of classes has three positive things in relation of studying in the online system. At first, we do not need to wake up so early to make the trip to school, or to wait for the bus at 7:25 am, because in these circumstances school is a few meters far from our bed. As we also have few classes, large breaks, not so much homework and a week plan send by our head teacher, it is easier to organize and optimize our time, so that we can leave a few hours to play or to disconnect from school. At last, we have more access to move and if you are hungry, you simply go to the kitchen (which should be no more than 20 meters from your workspace) and eat anything you want. 
The pandemic had brought the opportunity to realize at school activities that we do not make at presential school. We had made videos, presentations or homework in applications that we did not know before. Now, at classes we play in online platforms that maybe before we even did not think to use, like Quizziz, Kahoot, etc.
Though there are many advantages of studying from our home, there are also disadvantages about this, which are mostly the ones in which people only think of. The most common problem that online learning has, is about the internet. Nowadays we depend of the internet we have in our house, because without internet we cannot do the activities, tests, and we even cannot connect to our classes. This, from being a problem, became into an excuse, which sometimes is used in an improper way. For example, when a student is in the class, but he actually is somewhere else and the teacher ask him or her something, sometimes this student says that he or she could not listen because his internet is gone or is really bad. 
At the beginning we all knew that being in quarantine meant not seeing our friends, but when we started the online classes, I thought that it was an opportunity to see my friends. The thing is that nowadays I see in camera less than the half of the class, and I do not remember the faces of part of my classmates. This is not only something that most of the students care of, also for teachers is something important. Turning on the cameras, helps in getting to know each other, because most of the teachers do not know how we are physically, due to we have not been together for almost a year.
In conclusion, though there are many advantages and disadvantages, for us there will be always more disadvantages, because we only focus on that. Well, it does not matter how many bad things there are, but we need to get used to them, because the pandemic will be with us until who knows when. About advantages, the most important one is that by staying in our homes, we do not only take care of ourselves, we also are taking care of many people, and, who knows, maybe we are saving many lives by just having online classes.
